qualification: First checkpoint helper incorrectly forced core.autocrlf=false for verification. Existing evidence.mjs uses git hash-object --path and requires historical Windows clean conversion; false made unchanged S00-S02 CRLF artifacts appear stale. A separate verification-only helper restores effective historical true, proves the exact accepted Git blob without rewriting the artifact, and retains both reports. Source/docs scoped commits still use per-command false to preserve mixed unchanged file bytes. No global/repository config change, historical evidence rewrite, acceptance/cache/approval modification, build or test rerun.
